scope: Input Offload Route dynamic-flow boundary; no implementation

sources.fact: An explicit route_kind=offload action can create an Input logical flow in the official Ledger.
The real collector calls the AirFogSim offloading setter and records the route action before env.step.
Formal Live Planner bridge rejects non-empty Route and requires explicit NOOP.
Candidate grammar represents offload and return route kinds, but the current live bridge does not admit them.

conclusion: Input Offload has an official Ledger birth path and real setter path in the data collector, but formal Planner/Live bridge support remains outside this step. Dynamic Input Flow state update, model slot support and Scorer qualification are unverified.
